d: Long, flowing ash-blonde hair with voluminous curls and straight bangs frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, light-blue eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white long-sleeved blouse with a ruffled chest and blue bow, a high-waisted dark navy skirt with light blue accents and gold trim, and white tights paired with dark navy lace-up boots. A large, ornate white and navy blue headpiece sits atop the head, and the figure holds a massive, futuristic white and navy blue mechanical polearm with glowing blue accents.
